mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SIGNUP_VERIFICATION (TOKEN_HASH, IDENTIFY, EMAIL, PW_HASH, NICK, NAME, TEL, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{identify}, #{email}, #{pwHash}, #{nick}, #{name}, #{tel}, #{expiresAt}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_HASH, IDENTIFY, EMAIL, PW_HASH, NICK, NAME, TEL, EXPIRES_AT, USED_AT, CREATED_AT FROM SIGNUP_VERIFICATION WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND USED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SIGNUP_VERIFICATION SET USED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND USED_AT IS NULL
